run_unprocess_data: run the unprocess_data script to convert fairseq binary datasets back to raw text files
run_detokenize: run the detokenize function to convert BPE tokenized tokens back to raw character strings
run_load_dictionary: run the load_dictionary function to load a fairseq Dictionary from a dict.txt file path
run_load_dataset: run the load_dataset function to load a fairseq indexed dataset from a split path
run_load_bpe: run the load_bpe function to load BPE encoder.json and return bpe-to-index and index-to-bpe mappings
